title: Make an Interactive Book: In One Afternoon
subtitle: How the books on this shelf are written: a folder of plain HTML chapters, a few sliders, and one rule about numbers. Copy this book and replace its words with yours.
how: Read chapter 1, then copy the folder. This book is the template. Its source is the example.
Keep the page source open. Every component on screen is shown next to the HTML that made it.
credits: This guide is written with the engine it describes.
